Boundaries drop a candidate move before Jev ever sees it; sources say where a step's answer can also come from; costs are per-call credits measured on Sabo 2026-10-16 (Downloads/Sabo handoff/claude/MEASURED.md). Add a rule here, never an if-statement in the loop.

people_search.action: read the brand's own site: footer, about and careers pages
read the company's LinkedIn page in the background (jev-browse, read only)
run Claygent research on the brand's partnership owner (about 3 credits)

email_find.action: read the brand's own site for the email pattern its staff use

spend_evidence.action: read the brand's newsroom, launch and press pages for paid creator work
read the brand's public job board for creator, influencer or partnership roles
read the company's recent LinkedIn posts in the background (read only)

_not_orgs: Hosts a brand site links to that are platforms, not a related company. A link to one of these says nothing about ownership.
_infra_domains: Infrastructure a site loads or links that is never the brand's owner: site builders and hosting, CDNs, analytics and ad tags, accessibility widgets, and SaaS tools (feedback, chat, reviews, email, payments, consent). Added 2026-10-17 after the Sabo batch spent a 0.5-credit people search each on website-files.com and marker.io (Runna) and acsbapp.com, shopifysvc.com and shopifycdn.com (Zico). This list is the cross-check, not the gate: org_hop already needs an ownership sentence on the brand's site or about page (or emails found at the domain), and read_site keeps script, stylesheet and preconnect hosts out of links. Add a domain here when a replay shows it reaching a hop.
_math: ev = p / (credits + downstream credits + minutes * credit_per_minute + overhead) / (2 if irreversible). credit_per_minute and overhead are guessed, never measured: 0.02 makes a 12-hour wait for the client worth 14.4 credits, and 0.25 is one agent step plus a Jev call so a free read is never infinitely good. jev_weight says Jev's probability counts like that many recorded outcomes once the ledger has some.
_downstream: Credits a move still owes before the goal is met if it works. Keyed by the step a move reruns. A rerun people search that finds someone still pays for the email lookup and check, so it is ranked on 1.1 credits, not 0.5. Exact cost, not a judgment: added 2026-10-16 after the first replay ranked a 0.5-credit search rerun above a 0.6-credit email lookup that finishes the job.
_steps: Blocked steps the creator GTM tools report: people_search, email_find, buyer_rank (brand_buyer, follow_buyers), spend_evidence (spend_now: no dated creator-spend evidence), deliver_write (deliver: the ledger post or the record stamp failed), provider_unwired and credit_budget (a provider step raised NotWired or hit the credit allowance). A step with no sources and no rerun gets ask or stop.
